peers.name: triage
peers.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

peers.name: to-spec
peers.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker: no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

peers.name: to-tickets
peers.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker (edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker).

peers.name: grill-me
peers.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.

en.tagline: Configure a repo's issue tracker, labels, and domain docs
en.summary: This skill sets up per-repo configuration for the engineering skills. It records where issues are tracked, which label names the triage roles use, and where GLOSSARY.md and ADRs live. Run it once before you first use the other engineering skills.
problem: The engineering skills need to know where issues live, which label strings to use, and where the glossary and decision records are. Without that, they have to guess, or they write to the wrong place.
With this setup, those answers are written into the repo once. The agent-skills section in CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md points to docs/agents/ files that the other skills read.
fit: A new repo that will use the engineering skills for the first time
A repo that tracks issues on GitHub or GitLab, or in local markdown files under .scratch/
A repo whose existing triage labels have different names from the defaults
unfit: Repos that will not use the engineering skills
Teams that want the setup done by a fixed script with no review step, since this skill works by asking questions and confirming before it writes
steps: It explores the repo for a git remote, existing CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, glossary and ADR files, and monorepo signals.
It asks one section at a time: issue tracker first, then triage labels if the triage skill is available, then the domain docs layout.
It shows a draft of the agent-skills block and the docs/agents/ files so you can edit them before anything is written.
It adds or updates the agent-skills block in CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, editing whichever file already exists.
It writes the docs/agents/ files from its seed templates and creates any missing labels on GitHub or GitLab.

zh.tagline: 为仓库配置问题跟踪、标签和领域文档
zh.summary: 这个技能为工程类技能配置每个仓库的基础设置。它记录问题在哪里跟踪、分诊角色使用哪些标签名，以及 GLOSSARY.md 和 ADR 放在哪里。在首次使用其他工程类技能之前，运行一次即可。
problem: 工程类技能需要知道问题存放在哪里、使用哪些标签名，以及术语表和决策记录在哪里。如果没有这些信息，它们只能猜测，或者写到错误的位置。
用了这个技能之后，这些信息会一次性写入仓库。CLAUDE.md 或 AGENTS.md 中的 agent skills 部分会指向 docs/agents/ 下的文件，其他技能会读取这些文件。
fit: 第一次使用工程类技能的新仓库
问题记录在 GitHub、GitLab，或 .scratch/ 下本地 markdown 文件中的仓库
现有分诊标签名称与默认值不同的仓库
unfit: 不打算使用工程类技能的仓库
希望用固定脚本完成设置、不需要审阅步骤的团队，因为这个技能通过提问和确认来工作，写入前会让你确认
steps: 它检查仓库中的 git remote、已有的 CLAUDE.md 或 AGENTS.md、术语表和 ADR 文件，以及 monorepo 的迹象。
它每次只询问一个部分：先问问题跟踪，若 triage 技能可用再问分诊标签，最后问领域文档的布局。
它先展示 agent skills 段落和 docs/agents/ 文件的草稿，你可以在写入前修改。
它在 CLAUDE.md 或 AGENTS.md 中添加或更新 agent skills 段落，编辑已经存在的那个文件。
它用种子模板写入 docs/agents/ 文件，并在 GitHub 或 GitLab 上创建缺少的标签。
